Batch: 15 runs, 15 accepted, 15 flagged, 0 cleared.
- Flagged, check_failed_but_accepted, all three checks failed (r02, r06, r10, r12, r13, r15): rigid invariance 40–125 (threshold 2), closure 1.4–29.6 (threshold 1), plane sections 32–173 (threshold 3.25). r12 also has an off-batch profile: peak at 53 µm and growth zone of 105 µm. r13 and r15 have large flank differences (-173 and -92 %/h).
- Flagged, check_failed_but_accepted, rigid invariance and plane sections failed (r01, r05, r11): the tracker test failed. These runs also have off-batch profiles: REGR peaks of 74–122 %/h against a batch median of 42.5, and growth zones of 263–410 µm against a median of 526.
- Flagged, check_failed_but_accepted, plane sections failed (r03, r04, r14): 9.0–11.3 against 3.25, with the width-free ratio not used. Strain-rate summaries match the batch.
- Flagged, check_failed_but_accepted, closure failed (r07, r08, r09): 2.92–2.93 against 1.0. Strain-rate summaries match the batch.
What the flagged runs have in common: every run was accepted after at least one failed final check. No run kept a remedy, rolled back, used the width-free ratio or took more than one step. This points to a fault in the acceptance step for the whole batch, not in single roots. The acceptance logic should be reviewed and the batch re-run before any velocity, strain-rate or curvature result is reported.
